description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the SocialMediaAuthenticationService in the context of OpenID authentication. It contains setup routines and multiple test methods verifying functionalities like provider retrieval, initiation of authentication, redirect URL generation, scope retrieval, user authentication, setting user identity, and handling OAuth/OpenID Connect login flows.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the SocialMediaAuthenticationService related to OpenID Connect authentication workflows, including setup, provider retrieval, authentication initiation, user management, and session handling.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case environment and loads fixture data into the testing database.

methods.name: testGetAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Verifies that the service correctly returns an instance of AuthProviderDao.

methods.name: testInitiateAuthentication
methods.description: Tests that the initiateAuthentication method correctly creates an OpenID client with expected credentials and scope.

methods.name: testGetRedirectURL
methods.description: Checks that the getRedirectURL method generates the expected redirect URL using a mocked URL generator.

methods.name: testGetScope
methods.description: Verifies that getScope returns the 'email' scope as expected.

methods.name: testGetUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Tests retrieval of User entities based on provided user credentials.

methods.name: testSetOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Validates setting of user identity based on an OIDC provider for a given user.

methods.name: testHandleOIDCAuthentication
methods.description: Checks the overall flow of handling an OIDC authentication, including session interactions.
